topic: Uses and Properties of Organic Compounds
key_concepts: Organic compounds are composed mainly of carbon and hydrogen.
Carbon has four valence electrons and forms up to four covalent bonds.
Carbon can form single, double, and triple bonds in combinations totaling four bonds.
Carbon atoms bond with other carbon atoms through catenation to form chains and branches.
